items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment and retain only the existing period-aligned revenue, attribution, and cost reconciliation work item. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate Amazon commission. The $4.92 is assigned to aggregate tracking row `other`, not to sites; named site-attributed income is $0, which does not prove zero site performance. AI usage covers 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-28: 4,926 calls, 228 errors, 5 transient errors, and $901.90 recorded AI cost across 39 instrumented sites. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable: revenue and AI-cost periods do not align, infrastructure/domain/labor/marketing/experiment costs are absent or incomplete, monthly budget ceilings are blank, and no learning outcome or maximum learning-cost threshold exists. The minimum evidence is a same-period ledger reconciling attributable revenue by site/content/tracking ID, AI and all other recorded costs, approved budget ceilings, and a defined learning outcome with a maximum cost-to-learn. Do not treat clicks, orders, shipped items, sessions, conversions, AI calls, output counts, or treatment-versus-control throughput as financial performance or causal lift. Do not create new proposals, telemetry, spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization changes, deployments, or requeues; continue existing reconciliation only.

Handoff: retain and continue work item 67ebb985-a7b8-47f4-9792-b4d727275c4a only. Preserve the aggregate provider row as unattributed, reconcile recorded revenue and costs for matching periods, and document missing infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, and experiment cost categories. Escalate only when the minimum finance evidence is attached; do not create duplicate financial work or infer margin, ROI, payback, budget capacity, cost-to-learn, or causal lift.
